---
title: "Home"
---

Headings whose auto-generated id loses content in q2. Each heading's
expected Pandoc/Quarto 1 id is given underneath.

## Using a "raw" volume

`using-a-raw-volume` — quoted span dropped.

## See [the docs](https://example.com) now

`see-the-docs-now` — link text dropped.

## Use ~~strike~~ here

`use-strike-here` — strikeout dropped.

## Math $x+y$ inline

`math-xy-inline` — math dropped.

## Small [caps]{.smallcaps} here

`small-caps-here` — span dropped.

## Use *emphasis* and **strong** and `code` here

`use-emphasis-and-strong-and-code-here` — control: these three are the
only container/leaf kinds `collect_text` handles, and they survive.
